publicationDecision.authorisation: Standing Medicines Watch instruction: supported factual additions and corrections may go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Add two newly posted sponsor-submitted switching-study records to the existing zenagamtide and survodutide entries. This is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

configuredSourcePass.result: All configured sources were current and reviewed. A successful retrieval did not renew any factual review date or approve changed wording.

fields.summaryToAppend: A sponsor-submitted Phase 1 record, first posted 2 October 2026, plans to assess tolerability in an estimated 60 adults switching from maintenance semaglutide to subcutaneous zenagamtide.
fields.limitationsToAppend: The switching study remains not yet recruiting, has no posted results and retains an already-past 30 September 2026 estimated start; it does not establish that dosing has begun, comparative efficacy or safety, or a recommended switching regimen.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07855133: switching from semaglutide to zenagamtide
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted Phase 1 record read for not-yet-recruiting status, estimated enrolment and dates, injectable intervention, tolerability endpoint and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

fields.summaryToAppend: A sponsor-submitted Phase 3b SYNCHRONIZE-START record plans a pragmatic initiation study in an estimated 350 adults, including people switching from semaglutide or tirzepatide to survodutide.
fields.limitationsToAppend: SYNCHRONIZE-START remains not yet recruiting, has no posted results and lists 7 November 2026 as an estimated start. Its open-label design, in which all participants receive survodutide, does not provide comparator-based evidence or establish a validated switching schedule.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07855900: SYNCHRONIZE-START
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted Phase 3 record read for not-yet-recruiting status, estimated enrolment and dates, prior semaglutide or tirzepatide use, intervention, primary endpoint and absence of posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

discoveryDecision.included: Both records add useful formulation- and switching-specific evidence to existing programmes, so they update those entries rather than inflate the programme count.
discoveryDecision.plannedVersusCompleted: Both studies remain not yet recruiting and neither has posted results. Estimated starts are not presented as actual first dosing.
discoveryDecision.formulation: The zenagamtide record concerns the subcutaneous formulation; it does not advance or describe oral zenagamtide development.
discoveryDecision.ukPosition: The records do not establish UK marketing authorisation, NICE or NHS England access, actual UK supply or sale by SHIFT.
discoveryDecision.monitoring: No automatic source baseline, successful configured-source check or medical-review renewal is created by this publication.
discoveryDecision.coverage: This registry pass is not exhaustive and does not establish industry completeness.
